title: some thoughts on survivor 49 #rizgod #survivor50 #survivor49 #reality...
transcript: I didn't love survivor 49, and I'm a little sad about it because I mostly think it's because I knew who was going to be on 50. It definitely took a lot of steam out of the season, cause especially, like, an early jury, I was like, there's no way either of them are going home because they're going to 50. That being said, I am so excited to see Savannah and Rizzo play on 50. I think they are just both really good TV and really, really interesting players. Nobody on 50 other than Savannah and Rizzo will know what happened on 49. I assume they'll find out, or they'll be told that Savannah won, but they will not know that Savannah and Rizzo were as close as they were. I was Kyle and Camilla. I'd be pissed because they left, like, right after that season finished. For everyone knew they were, like, the big secret duo. Savannah and Rizzo have a lot of opportunity here. Like, if I am them, I'm like, we hated each other. We were rivals. We went to fire against each other. She beat me. I'll never forgive her. And the whole time they just work together and, like, feed information back and forth. It's logically to me, it makes more sense that if you're gonna do two allies, or like three, if you count Joe 48, that you would do two enemies 49. I think Savannah and Rizzo could both cause a lot Of chaos as Rizzo just makes choices sometimes that I think are baffling but ultimately pretty much paid off for him. If he just knew how to make a fire. Perfect world. I would have liked 50 to have no winners. If we're gonna have three winners from the last 10 years, D, Kyle, and Savannah do make the most sense to me. And I think Savannah and D could have a really interesting dynamic. Either they'll be best best best best best friends, or they'll absolutely despise each other. Anyway. I get people are mixed on it. I get people don't like Savannah, but I think that they are good choices. I totally understand after watching the season why they would make room to include them on 50. I do hope we get a second chance this season also. Maybe in like, I don't know, 53 and Soph gets to come back. Because I just love Soph and I love her gameplay and I would love to see her on another season of survivor. Way. I can't believe 50 is like 2 months away. That's crazy.
